scene: Your happy dog munches the pastry as three skyway transports arrive together.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the zinc terrace at dusk. Far left, a red double-decker hover bus hovers beside the railing with doors open. Left of centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit holds the brass key, her white dog licking its snout. Centre, a striped gondola drone sways. Far right, a green flying scooter sits waiting.
shown: a red double-decker hover bus hovering by the roof edge on the far left
a striped gondola drone hooked to a mooring post in the centre
a pastel-green flying scooter parked on its stand on the far right
